message: Vector Rebel v2.3.8 beta is current.
releaseNotes: Direct core fix for false Item Log verification warnings. Completed history rows are no longer de-duplicated by visible text; same-day duplicate rows retain true multiplicity, and completion requires a settled pre-submit baseline followed by exactly one new COMPLETE row matching the inspector and inspection mode. Removes the v2.3.7 mirror/runtime workaround.
